Supreme Court Hears Privacy Law Challenge

articles.headline: Indian Media Outlets Contest Modi’s Privacy Law
articles.brief: Major Indian publishers, including outlets tied to Ambani and Adani, are challenging the government's privacy legislation in the Supreme Court, arguing it impacts press freedom and transparency.

articles.headline: India Approves $22 Billion in Military Purchases
articles.brief: The Indian government has granted in-principle approval for $22 billion in major military acquisitions to bolster national defense capabilities and modernize its armed forces.

articles.headline: Ather Energy Posts First Ever Quarterly Profit
articles.brief: Electric scooter maker Ather Energy has reported its first-ever quarterly profit, driving a 10% surge in its share price as demand for EV solutions accelerates.

articles.headline: Infosys Cuts Revenue View Citing AI and Competition
articles.brief: Shares of Indian IT major Infosys fell after the company lowered its revenue growth forecast, highlighting intensifying competitive pressures and the disruptive impact of artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: Verizon Signs $2B AI Infrastructure Deal with AWS
articles.brief: Telecommunications giant Verizon has lifted its annual forecasts following a massive cloud and AI infrastructure partnership worth over $2 billion with Amazon Web Services.

articles.headline: Anthropic Files For IPO With Chilling AI Warning
articles.brief: AI startup Anthropic has filed for its initial public offering on Nasdaq, cautioning investors about the extreme future risks of advanced AI systems escaping human control.

articles.headline: Microsoft Extends Voluntary Buyouts to 60,000 Staff
articles.brief: Tech major Microsoft has announced a buyout program for approximately 60,000 employees across India, the US, the UK, and Canada, offering standard severance with no tenure requirements.

articles.headline: US Appeals Court Limits Detained Migrant Rights
articles.brief: The US Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit ruled that immigrants detained after illegal entry are not constitutionally entitled to individualized bond hearings.

articles.headline: Iran Fears Escalation as US Midterms Approach
articles.brief: Tehran is bracing for potential full-scale hostilities as the US bolsters military presence in the Middle East and domestic political dynamics shift ahead of elections.

articles.headline: Gold Rises as Lower Oil Prices Ease Inflation
articles.brief: Precious metals gained ground as declining crude oil prices tempered near-term global inflation fears ahead of the upcoming Federal Reserve policy meeting.

articles.headline: Budget 2027 May Consider Cutting Long-Term Capital Gains
articles.brief: The Indian government is reportedly evaluating proposals to lower the 12.5% long-term capital gains tax in the upcoming budget to revitalize domestic and foreign market sentiment.

articles.headline: Double Fortified Salt Offers Solution to Anaemia
articles.brief: Public health experts highlight double fortified salt as a scalable, low-cost dietary intervention to tackle widespread iron deficiency and malnutrition across developing nations.

articles.headline: De La Fuente and Pere Romeu Win Ballon d'Or
articles.brief: Luis de la Fuente and Pere Romeu took home the prestigious men's and women's coach of the year honors at the annual Ballon d'Or ceremony.

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab Threatens India’s Eastern Coast
articles.brief: Authorities in eastern India are rapidly evacuating thousands of residents as severe Cyclone Arnab approaches coastal regions, threatening heavy infrastructural damage.
